scope: Recover #2220 stages1-3, preserve completed Stage0. Original candidate b874 is not an ancestor; actual composition merge443c is.

original.text: Competitive analytics release: hourly series, latency histograms, model and tool tables, session ledger enrichment, and coding-agent panels, all from existing telemetry

body.conditions: PROVENANCE: operator direction, hugh, 2026-08-31, on the checker gap analysis against Sentry AI Agents dashboards (notes/2026-08-31-sentry-agents-dashboard-gap-analysis.md, currently untracked in the repo working tree; adopt it into notes/ as the first commit of stage 0 so it is reviewable): "yes, pass on 5 but let us do the others" - i.e. items 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 of that note are tasked; item 5 (per-session step ledger) is explicitly NOT tasked; item 7 goes to #2193 by separate assert. HARD CONSTRAINT: no capture-scope expansion - every dimension must come from attributes the harnesses already emit under their default or already documented gates; no prompts, tool arguments, tool content, or session stores; no invented vocabularies (each attribute traceable to official docs or a scrubbed fixture). STAGE 0 (prerequisite): adopt the note; capture a fresh scrubbed Claude Code fixture from the current release covering api_request (model, cost_usd_micros, duration_ms, token families, query_source, agent.name), api_error (model, status_code, duration_ms, attempt), tool_result (tool_name, success, duration_ms, tool_input_size_bytes, tool_result_size_bytes, decision_source), tool_decision (decision, source, tool_source), mcp_server_connection (status, transport_type, duration_ms, error_code), api_refusal, permission_mode_changed; document any attribute in the note that the live release does not actually emit. STAGE 1 (items 1+3, one activity-stats revision): hourly grain hour_utc = day_utc*24+hour in activity-stats - activity_hourly(harness, hour_utc, event_family) with record/request/tool/success/failure/outcome-unknown counts, duration total+observed count, token families, cost - and replace the five fixed duration buckets with a log-spaced histogram (about 16 edges from 50 ms to 5 min) in request_performance and the hourly table, keeping Codex ttft_ms as a separate histogram; document P50/P95 interpolation and its error bound in the README recipes. This changes writable tables: plan and document it as a reset-activation release for activity-stats and state that plainly in the report; keep other bundles unchanged in this stage. STAGE 2 (item 2): model_requests(harness, model, hour_utc): requests, errors from api_error, duration histogram, tokens by family, cost, model_coverage observed/unknown (Codex has no model attribute in the observed 0.150.1 fixture - report unknown, do not infer); tool_calls(harness, tool_name, hour_utc): calls, failures, duration histogram, input/result size totals where present, and Claude Code tool_decision reject counts by source. OPERATOR-RATIFIED POSTURE DECISION: raw tool_name becomes an analytics dimension (un-gated in all three harnesses, bounded cardinality, already retained in guard findings); state the change in the activity-stats README privacy section and the root README catalog row. STAGE 3 (items 4+6): session_activity gains agents observed (main/subagent/auxiliary request counts and distinct agent.name values as a bounded JSON array), api_error count, and observed duration total, with a documented join to session_cost_detail; plus the coding-agent panels as exports: permission decisions by source and permission_mode transitions over time, MCP connection health (status/transport/duration/failures per hour, names remain redacted), refusals by model, cached-input share per hour. DELIVERY: each stage at an exact committed head with a review request to checker; go test ./..., go vet ./..., go test -race ./..., scripts/demo.sh pass at every head; fixtures and embed/normalizer tests for every new column; bundle READMEs give one query recipe per new Sentry-equivalent panel (agent runs, LLM calls, duration avg+p95, calls/tokens/cost by model, calls/errors by tool, models table, tools table, sessions table); continue-vs-reset consequences stated per stage; no RuntimeID change unless a stage explicitly justifies it. Checker will verify histogram interpolation against fixture durations and that every new dimension is traceable to the stage-0 fixture or official docs.

stage0_approval.text: APPROVED at exact head b874243a6a5c05fc5fc56b4b646d3f9a4dc52cf5 (one commit atop main c43e7b3: gap-analysis note adopted, Claude Code 2.1.251 fixture, fixture test, claude-code.md, demo.sh). Clean worktree: go vet OK, go test 14 ok, go test -race 14 ok, scripts/demo.sh exit 0, no rm forms. FIXTURE: seven scrubbed records (api_request, subagent api_request, api_error, tool_result, failed tool_result, tool_decision, failed mcp_server_connection); my scan finds zero UUIDs, emails, or filesystem paths, session.id is the literal session-scrubbed, models are only claude-fable-5 / claude-opus-5, and the attribute set is exactly the documented un-gated vocabulary (agent.name, query_source, cost_usd_micros, duration_ms, token families, status_code, attempt, decision, tool_source, tool_input/result_size_bytes, transport_type, error_code). TestCurrentClaudeFixtureDocumentsStageZeroEvidence enforces the privacy allowlist (prompt, response, tool_input, tool_parameters, user.*, organization.*, request_id, tool_use_id, message.uuid forbidden), asserts the stage-0 evidence values (subagent attribution Explore, 401 status, failed tool, CONNECTION_CLOSED), and proves session-cost normalizes the current api_request. NOTE: adopted as a condensed 126-line version of my draft with an Operator disposition section (items 1-4 and 6 tasked, per-session step ledger excluded pending retention design), Sentry panel summary, current-gap table, evidence section, and staged plan; the evidence section honestly records that api_refusal and permission_mode_changed did not arise in the controlled run and remain documented vendor possibilities rather than fixture-proven inputs, that app.version/skill/plugin/mcp names were unexercised, gated, or redacted, and that Codex model coverage remains unknown - exactly the no-invented-vocabulary posture the request demanded. claude-code.md updated to cite the 2.1.251 fixture and what it proves. Stage 0 complete; stage 1 (hourly grain + log-spaced histogram in activity-stats, planned as a reset release) may proceed. Advisory: the demo.sh cleanup rewrite appears identically on three parallel branches (this, the URL note, the README brief) and in a different textual form on the timestamp branch; land one and rebase the rest to avoid conflicts.
